note: Owner, era, type, function, cover, public knowledge, jurisdiction, status and hooks per installation. No exact coordinates are recorded, deliberately: the source gives regions, not points, and an invented grid reference would be a claim the material does not support.

entries.label: Bahamas / Caribbean seabed complex
entries.region: Southern waters near the Bahamas; Caribbean approaches
entries.function: docks, logistics, biological work, Orion ingress
entries.cover: oceanographic survey, cable maintenance, drug-interdiction cooperation
entries.jurisdiction: contested: national waters, several flags, no single authority
entries.status_2045: the alliance's material origin and its most dangerous site; reached late in a campaign
hooks: a chartered vessel's manifest disagrees with its AIS track
a survey contractor's insurance claim describes a hull breach at a depth that should have crushed it

entries.label: Pacific installations near the Chilean maritime border
entries.status_2045: human-operated; an Orion connection is suggested by the wider South American region but is not confirmed by the source
hooks: a Chilean navy exercise is cancelled without explanation and nobody in the region will say why

entries.label: Orion submerged approaches, South America
entries.function: Orion bases; landing and departure routes
entries.cover: none: the source describes concealment, not a human cover story
entries.jurisdiction: plural; the region is where the alliance's paperwork fails
entries.status_2045: Orion network, linked to the Bahamas by in-world intelligence rather than by source certainty
hooks: a fishing community reports a light beneath the water on the same date every year
an abductee's account contains a route detail that matches a shipping lane

entries.label: Orion facilities near the northern pole
entries.function: Orion stronghold and historical intrusion corridor
entries.jurisdiction: outside or contested by every Arctic state
entries.status_2045: separate from the Caribbean complex; a corridor, not a headquarters
hooks: an Arctic research station's ice-core data shows a cavity where the bedrock should be

entries.label: Lunar installations
entries.era: under rework in 1981; status after the Crisis open
entries.public_knowledge: public programmes are known; the military layer is not
entries.jurisdiction: no sovereign claim survives the Crisis intact
entries.status_2045: OPEN: which installations fell to Orion after the Crisis, and whether anyone on Earth knows
hooks: a commercial lunar relay goes silent for eleven minutes and returns with a different clock

entries.label: Mobile ground bases
entries.function: staging nodes that are never where the file says
entries.jurisdiction: whatever country the convoy is crossing
entries.status_2045: useful as moving staging nodes; do not treat them as fixed map points
hooks: a customs anomaly: a convoy that declares more axles than it has

entries.label: Airborne bases
entries.jurisdiction: airspace, which is where jurisdiction gets interesting
entries.status_2045: a plausible source of the UAP reports a Europol officer must explain without invoking aliens
hooks: a transponder code appears in two flight plans at once

entries.label: Underground manufacture, New Mexico
entries.function: craft manufacture, one at a time
entries.public_knowledge: decades of folklore that the source does not corroborate
entries.jurisdiction: US federal, and after the Crisis whatever the shattered American sphere became
entries.status_2045: black-program manufacturing, later hybrid corporate research
hooks: a defence contractor's environmental filing lists a solvent used only in aerospace composites

entries.label: Underground manufacture, arid Mexico
entries.function: craft manufacture, one at a time
entries.cover: a bacteriological-warfare research installation, which the host government believed it was
entries.jurisdiction: Mexican sovereignty, with a bilateral arrangement the source describes as misrepresented
entries.status_2045: cross-border compartment; not identical to New Mexico, and not to be merged with it
hooks: a 1970s bilateral agreement surfaces in a declassification batch with its annex missing

entries.label: Area 51 / Groom Lake
entries.physical_type: surface airfield with underground elements (fictional option)
entries.era: post-1955 (real test site); NoöPunk role OPEN
entries.function: aviation test and recovery, if the author adopts it
entries.cover: the real cover: a test facility
entries.public_knowledge: widely known as a secret facility
entries.status_2045: OPEN: not named by Ra in the cited passages and not established as an Orion base
hooks: a declassified budget line for a facility that officially did not exist

entries.label: Dulce, New Mexico
entries.function: OPEN: hidden facility, folklore, or disinformation the faction encourages
entries.jurisdiction: US federal, and tribal jurisdiction over the land itself
entries.status_2045: OPEN: decide before canonising; the legend is useful either way
hooks: a tribal land dispute turns on a survey that does not match the federal map

entries.label: Wright-Patterson AFB
entries.era: 1947-1969 for the real UFO investigation; NoöPunk role optional
entries.function: archival and intelligence node, if the author adopts it
entries.cover: an air force base and its research laboratories
entries.public_knowledge: known as the home of Project Blue Book
entries.status_2045: optional archival node, not an automatic Orion combat base
hooks: a records request returns a box that was transferred to a command that no longer exists

entries.label: Hyvinkää Zone, Finland
entries.cover: not applicable: this is public, governed and contested
entries.jurisdiction: Finnish state and City of Helsinki arrangements
entries.status_2045: NOT an Orion or MJ-12 site. Corporate or SETI intersections are possible; control is not established and must not be implied
hooks: an Orion-linked supplier wins a zone contract and the investigation is about procurement, not aliens

entries.label: Mars and the asteroid belt — Eldrich holdings
entries.public_knowledge: public as commerce, opaque as ownership
entries.jurisdiction: corporate charter, EU trade law, and a great deal of distance
entries.status_2045: proxy-era infrastructure; distinct from the 1981 base map
hooks: a Mars-bound cargo manifest lists a component whose only manufacturer is a 1978 US programme
